rootCause: According to the official WeChat account of Ping An Xuhui, employees Zhang, Dong, and Liu from Company A decided in early March 2023 to insert a backdoor program into a certain cryptocurrency wallet software to obtain users' private keys. The three individuals illegally obtained over 27,000 mnemonic phrases and more than 10,000 private keys, successfully converting over 19,000 digital wallet addresses.
